summary.intent: Resolve PR #558 review threads (return type fix + doc improvement for inode.rs), then improve unit test coverage for the patch lines in crates/fuse/src/fs.rs drain_refresh_completions.
summary.outcome: Both review threads replied to and resolved; PR #558 pushed with fix commits. Four new unit tests added for drain_refresh_completions covering both branches, no-clobber guarantee, and Failure arm — 96 tests passing, clippy clean.

repo: crates/fuse/src/fs.rs has a make_test_fs / make_test_fs_with_keypair helper that builds a full CipherBoxFS with root_folder_key and tokio runtime handle, enabling synchronous unit tests for drain_refresh_completions.
CI measures coverage via cargo-llvm-cov in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
drain_refresh_completions patch lines (both if/else branches + fall-through spawn) were previously only exercised by desktop-e2e tests, not unit tests.
The get_unresolved_file_pointers_for_parent function drives spawning; the caller must still invoke it after drain_refresh_completions mutates in place.
inode.rs:1041 uses > instead of != (vs populate_folder's !=) intentionally: behind-clock remote edits are deferred inside the mutation window (local-wins) and reconciled later by populate_folder.

code.finding: Return type changed to () — the Vec was dead (call site discards it); get_unresolved_file_pointers_for_parent drives the spawn. Doc updated to state it only mutates in place.
Deliberate > comparison (vs populate_folder's !=): behind-clock remote edits deferred inside mutation window for local-wins, reconciled later by populate_folder. Inline rationale added.
New #[tokio::test] module added for drain_refresh_completions — 4 tests covering both branches, no-clobber guarantee, and Failure arm using make_test_fs scaffolding.

workflow: After a push to a PR branch, GitHub marks the PR as BLOCKED while required checks re-trigger — this is expected pending state, not a failure.
.planning/ bookkeeping commits should be bundled with related code in the same PR, not in a separate PR.
Fire-and-forget tokio spawns don't need to be polled in #[tokio::test] — channel sends and bookkeeping state assertions are sufficient to cover the patch lines.

friction: PR was temporarily marked BLOCKED after push due to CI re-triggering — required a follow-up check to confirm no actual failures.
A separate PR (#559) had been opened for doc changes that belonged in #558 — required cherry-pick, close, and branch deletion to consolidate.
open_items: Cross-platform cargo checks and Release Preview CI run still pending at end of session — #558 not yet mergeable.
